description: Plant Science explores how plants live and how people grow them: flower parts and photosynthesis, what plants need, soil, propagation, native and invasive plants, and an in-depth option such as agronomy, horticulture or fruit and nut crops.
outlineNote: The 2025 update added a new requirement 8 and changed the Agronomy option. Excerpts showed the general requirements and options but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
